```{r}
#| label: pkgs
use("tibble", "lst")
use("glue", "glue")
```

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: false
pkg_nm <- "tidywigits"
org_nm <- "tidywf"
ver <- as.character(utils::packageVersion(pkg_nm))
conda <- tibble::lst(
  pkg = paste0("r-", pkg_nm),
  env = paste0(pkg_nm, "_env"),
  url = glue("https://anaconda.org/{org_nm}/{pkg}")
)
dir_nemo  <- system.file("doc-templates", "installation", package = "nemo")
```
